### Atlas Administration API

- **Atlas Administration API** · part — - Query Shape Reports are not available through the Atlas Administration API. · aka: Admin API, Administration API, API v2, atlas api, Atlas CLI, atlas cli, processId, host:port, Project Read Only, Project Owner, service account, API key, since, duration, namespaces — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md#limitations

### slow query log

- **slow query log** · part — Slow query log messages contain new metrics if the query execution writes temporary files to disk. These metrics are prefixed by the query execution stage that caused the query to exceed the memory limit. For example, sortSpills indicates the number of times that the sort stage of query execution wr · aka: slow query, slow operations, slowms, slow operation threshold, Query Profiler, query profiler — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/log-messages/

### automation

- **automation** · related — Index creation through the Performance Advisor UI is one index at a time, and is unavailable if Data Explorer is disabled for the project; for automation, create suggested indexes from mongosh, a driver, or the API instead of the Advisor UI. · aka: script, scheduled, polling, pipeline, CI, ticket, webhook, cron — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/performance-advisor/
